# Software Bill of Materials

Human-readable rendering of [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json) (CycloneDX 1.6, document version 6) for **dev-setup** — Interactive, idempotent dev-toolchain installer for Ubuntu 26.04 (with target-OS selection)

**110 components** (28 application, 4 container, 74 library, 4 machine-learning-model). Generated by `scripts/sbom-md.py`; CI fails if this file is out of date with the CycloneDX source.

### gemma4-26b-a4b-it-qat

- **Type:** machine-learning-model
- **Supplier:** Google
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **purl:** `pkg:generic/gemma4@26b-a4b-it-qat`
- **Resolution:** latest of the 26b-a4b-it-qat tag, resolved at install time
- **Note:** Quantization-aware-trained 26B MoE (3.8B active). Chosen over the 31B dense, whose sliding-window KV cost caps usable context near 32-40K on a 24GB GPU. Variant pinned at num_ctx 131072.
- **Depends on / installs with it:** —
- **Required by:** [Ollama](#ollama)

### Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (IQ4_XS GGUF)

- **Type:** machine-learning-model
- **Supplier:** NVIDIA (quant by Unsloth)
- **License:** NVIDIA Open Model License
- **purl:** `pkg:huggingface/unsloth/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-GGUF`
- **Resolution:** opt-in (DEV_SETUP_OLLAMA_NEMOTRON=1); latest IQ4_XS shard at install time
